title: The Blueprint for Co-Investments: Investing Directly in Private Equity
summary: We explore the evolving co-investment landscape and the role disciplined underwriting, selectivity, and portfolio construction can play in building a private equity co-investment program.
body_markdown:
A co-investment is only as strong as the disciplined analysis behind it.
